label_definition.timing: signal at t, entry at t+1 mark, exit at t+1+h mark
label_definition.label: sign((mark[t+1+h]/mark[t+1])-1) with threshold
label_definition.hit_definition: rule hit_rate = predicted directional sign matches label sign on non-flat labels
label_definition.baseline_definition: majority directional class accuracy over non-flat labels
